narrative.details:
Arygos theorizes that the element which is born of conflicts between the Old Gods and their minions is also extremely deadly to them under the right conditions. I speak of Elementium, mortal.

Find and bring me Imperial Qiraji Regalia and the toxic element and I shall infuse weapons of great power.
narrative.objectives: Merithra of the Dream in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj will create Elementium Infused Armaments for you should you bring her Imperial Qiraji Regalia and 3 Elementium Ore.
narrative.offerRewardText: Use the item well, adventurer. Let them feel the pain that they so dearly wish to inflict upon others.
narrative.requestItemsText: You will strike them down and free us of these bonds.
